correctness.rationale: The Hardy coefficient formula was reconstructed, and W_t was factored into two Hilbert–Schmidt operators. Its Gram kernel is the product of geometric weights and one plus the smaller matrix index. An arbitrary principal minor is exactly the product of the geometric factors and positive integer index gaps. Summing all gaps gives the \(k\)-th elementary symmetric coefficient \(t^{k(k-1)}/\prod_{j=1}^k(1-t^{2j})^2\), and trace-class Fredholm continuity proves the entire determinant series. Termwise substitution into the explicitly normalized order-zero Hahn–Exton series is exact. The Gram operator has no kernel, and a second-order difference recurrence with one free initial parameter gives one-dimensional eigenspaces, so every determinant zero is positive and simple. The exact-rational finite checker passed for \(t=1/2\) and \(t=2/3\); it was not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The point-mass Rhaly family is the canonical integrand in positive-measure Cesaro/Rhaly operators, and determining every singular value gives exact best Hilbert-space rank-j approximation errors, trace/HS spectral sums, and the operator norm, far stronger than known ordinary spectrum or inclusion in Schatten ideals. The Hahn–Exton link is a reusable structural correspondence to nontrivial special-function zero theory, not a routine normalization or arbitrary finite computation. Scope excludes general moments and other Hardy exponents.
